Definition: from a compound of G4314 and χέω (to pour); a shedding forth, i.e. affusion:--sprinkling.
BiblicalUsage: Proschysis means a sprinkling, a pouring out upon. It appears once, in the faith of Moses: through faith he kept the passover, and the sprinkling of blood, lest he that destroyed the firstborn should touch them.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the blood on the doorposts is the whole gospel in miniature: death passes over where the blood has been sprinkled.
